import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_26/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_26/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on 'city' as specified
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Reorder columns to match target schema: ['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']
df_final = df_joined[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
df_final['city'] = df_final['city'].astype(str)
df_final['driver_count'] = df_final['driver_count'].astype(int)
df_final['type'] = df_final['type'].astype(str)
df_final['date'] = df_final['date'].astype(str)
df_final['fare'] = df_final['fare'].astype(float)
df_final['ride_id'] = df_final['ride_id'].astype(int)

# Write the final dataframe to the target path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
